89: 1. Through the stories of tzaddikim, the light of the Mashiach is drawn into the world, much darkness and suffering is dispelled from the world, and also one merits to attractive clothing.
2. Through repentance, the Spirit of the Mashiach wafts upon the harsh decrees of the nations (lit. kingdoms) and annuls them.

3. In the future, there will be a generation in the world that will be totally innocent. [See Sanh. 98b: R' Yochanan says, The son of David will come only in a generation that is entirely innocent, or in a generation that is entirely guilty]
4. Through Truth, the End (of the exile) will come (t.n. See Truth, book two, #9).
5. Through keeping the Shabbat one draws upon oneself the light of the Mashiach, also through repentance.
